requirement.statement: The logic package SHALL compile StructureSchema and optional EditorPresentation into a renderer-neutral EditorPlan through processors shaped as output = fn(runtime, input, config), with the scoped dialect owned by runtime.

case.given: A nested object containing array, map, union, scalar, and ref schemas
case.then: The compiler SHALL produce stable recursive plan nodes, wildcard templates, paths, provenance, and diagnostics without renderer or host writer dependencies

case.given: A function-bearing SchemaEditorDialect and serializable compile options
case.when: The compiler runtime is assembled and invoked
case.then: The dialect SHALL be read from runtime and SHALL NOT be passed through config

requirement.statement: The compiler SHALL own fixed transformer selection and a default structural dialect without exposing a resolver, registry, classifier, or caller-owned precedence surface.

case.given: Presenter, scoped semantic, format, and structural candidates exist
case.then: The compiler SHALL use presenter, semantic, format, structural, then unsupported order

case.given: No candidate transformer can compile a node
case.then: The compiler SHALL emit an unsupported diagnostic and SHALL NOT select an implicit raw JSON presenter

requirement.statement: The compiler runtime factory SHALL compose default, shared, bounded-context, and editor-instance dialect layers deterministically without mutating source dialects.

case.given: Two runtimes bind different transformers for the same semantic type
case.when: The same schema is compiled in each runtime
case.then: Each plan SHALL use its own scoped transformer without leaking the binding to the other runtime

case.given: Multiple ordered layers bind the same transformer key
case.then: The later layer SHALL win and all input dialect objects SHALL remain unchanged

requirement.statement: Collection, map, and union plan bindings SHALL represent event-time Command arguments without embedding apply callbacks, concrete fake indices, or host persistence effects.

case.given: A collection plan with insert, remove, and move interactions
case.when: The plan is compiled before a concrete UI event exists
case.then: Its command bindings SHALL describe event-sourced index/value arguments as serializable neutral data
